title: GOV-0023: no repository-research subskill; a repo-type research record's baseline is not required to resolve (RSR-006 / control 3)
problem:
## Observed
The frozen research contract (#50) names nine P0 subskills; none exist. `repository-research` — BADF-native investigation of a repository's commits, PRs, issues, code and history, binding findings to a commit SHA — has no `SKILL.md`. And control 3 ("baseline is bound to a repository revision when repository research applies") is not enforced: a record of type `R02` (REPOSITORY_INVESTIGATION) or `R03` (ROOT_CAUSE) can baseline to a commit that does not exist in the repo, and `badf_gate.py research` accepts it.

## Expected
A concise `skills/badf-research/subskills/repository-research/SKILL.md` (a declarative workflow, like `badf-delivery`), a registry entry for it, and control 3 enforced: for a repo-type record (R02/R03), `baseline.repository` must be registered and `baseline.revision` must resolve there (an absent LOCAL_MIRROR reports `UNRESOLVABLE_HERE`, like `verify_foreign_revision`). A shipped `examples/research-record-repo.json` (a real R02 investigation) validated in CI.

## Evidence
`ls skills/badf-research/subskills` → absent on `main` at `39dc6d9`; `grep -n '"R02"\|"R03"' scripts/badf_gate.py` → `validate_research_record` never resolves a baseline.

## Unknowns
None. Control 6 (source-digest staleness, needs a source fetch) remains a separate later WP; the other eight P0 subskills follow one at a time. `badf-research` stays `DESIGNED` until all controls and subskills land.

## Proposed work package
`BADF-WP-0040` (RSR-006). The `repository-research` SKILL.md + registry entry; control 3 in `validate_research_record`; `examples/research-record-repo.json`; tests + mutation. C2. Brings 16 of 18 controls to enforced.
